verdict.rationale: Ollama's download page documents a one-line install script, and community reports confirm ready-made macOS/Windows apps and shipped ROCm containers. Together these show installation without compiling from source. However, the evidence never explicitly describes the artifacts as prebuilt binaries or lists the supported packages and platforms, so coverage is incomplete. missing for 10: first-party documentation that explicitly describes prebuilt binaries or packages per OS/architecture (e.g. Windows/macOS installers, Linux package or tarball listings, official Docker image docs), and confirmation that the install script fetches precompiled artifacts.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install using prebuilt binaries or packages instead of compiling from source

citations.quote: Ollama's new app is now available for macOS and Windows
They have shipped ROCm containers since 0.1.27.
